item.title: Ente Community Discord Oct 10, 2026 - 64 messages in 8 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw moderate activity, led by discussions in #photos, with additional conversations about Ente Space, Ensu, authentication, and Locker design. Several threads focused on product feedback, troubleshooting, and upcoming app plans.

#photos

With 26 messages from 11 participants, the channel covered storage warnings, EXIF display and timestamp handling, birthday notifications, and whether live photos should autoplay. Members also discussed spam possibly related to Stripe’s OneLink billing service, including a OneLink link, and compared Ente’s autoplay behavior with alternatives.

#space

Thirteen messages from five participants introduced Ente Space as a private, ad-free social app for sharing photos with friends and family. The discussion confirmed that mobile apps are planned “soon,” that Space will remain a separate app rather than being integrated into Photos, and included requests for an AMOLED-black theme.

#ensu

Ten messages from four participants covered Ensu’s knowledge cutoff issues, macOS note-linking not updating, and a blank window when launching the AppImage on Manjaro. Members also discussed Obsidian indexing, notes search, and whether Ensu could qualify for Fairly Trained certification; the response was that Ensu is a model-switcher frontend rather than a model itself.

#auth

Seven messages from three participants resolved a channel visibility issue: users may need to enable channels through Channels & Roles or browse channels, since new channels cannot always be enabled automatically for long-standing members.

#locker

Five messages discussed alternative Locker logos, with members preferring a simpler lock icon over the current “e” design and hoping for more visual customization similar to Photos.

#introduce-yourself

A new member, Kavish Jain, introduced himself.
